notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have visited at least one Attraction this turn.
description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squirrel Squatters as attackers.
Squirrel Squatters triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Squirrel token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
